tests.code:
from shipping import fee

def test_standard_shipping_example(amount_cents):
    result = fee(amount_cents)
    assert isinstance(result, int)
    assert not isinstance(result, bool)
    assert result == 1000
tests.quote: For a built-in int amount_cents from 0 to 9999, shipping.fee(amount_cents) returns the integer 1000 cents; amount_cents equal to 500 is an explicit example.
tests.purpose: Check the explicit 500-cent input example and integer 1000-cent result.
